hypotheses.H15a: A persistent prompt-summary carry injected into every answer readout improves strict arithmetic+code IID free-generation exact by >=3pp over an exact CE continuation from the same parent.
hypotheses.H15b: Adding sequence-level hard-negative contrast to prompt carry improves strict IID exact by >=3pp over prompt carry CE alone and increases prediction diversity without >2pp transfer regression.

architecture.prompt_carry: same base + one scalar gate; normalized final prompt hidden is residually added to every answer hidden before final norm/tied LM head

training.optimizer: AdamW lr .0005 warmup20 cosine-to10%, betas(.9,.95), wd .01, clip1
training.init: exact G14R compact_shuffled parent for all arms; prompt carry gate=0

contrastive.negative: deterministic minimally changed arithmetic operator or final code operation; prefer same rendered answer length; no negative used at inference

objective: strict free generation F=<integer>+EOS; no solver/case/gold at inference or scoring
selection: fixed step600 only; no held-based checkpoint selection
scope: one-seed paired continuation screen; not Qwen parity and not 300-800M
